Message.Name: Open Interest Message
Message.Description: Reports Exchange and Market Open Interest for open positions in futures and options contracts. Exchange open interest volumes are provided per currency, by contract code, and not aggregated across currencies, whereas market open interest volumes are aggregated across currencies and reported against USD denominated instruments.

Field.Name: BusinessDate
Field.Description: The business date for which the open interest is being reported, as YYYYMMDD.

Field.Name: OpenInterestType
Field.Description: Type of open interest. The specification names this field Type; it is qualified here because the Reference FX Rate and Warrant Band messages give a Type of their own carrying different sets of values.

Field.Name: InstrumentID
Field.Description: Instrument to which the open interest applies.

Field.Name: ProductCode
Field.Description: The product code. This identifies the metal for the instrument.

Field.Name: ContractCode
Field.Description: Contract to which the instrument belongs.

Field.Name: ContractType
Field.Description: Constant contract type.

Field.Name: Volume
Field.Description: Number of open positions expressed in lots.

Message.Name: Open Interest Band Message
Message.Description: Reports open interest for all futures trades by product between given dates. Open interest volumes are provided per currency, by contract code, and not aggregated across currencies.

Field.Name: BusinessDate
Field.Description: The business date for which the open interest is being reported, as YYYYMMDD.

Field.Name: ProductCode
Field.Description: The product code.

Field.Name: ContractCode
Field.Description: Contract to which the open interest belongs.

Field.Name: ContractType
Field.Description: Constant contract type.

Field.Name: CurrencyCode
Field.Description: The currency code according to ISO 4217.

Field.Name: DateBandCount
Field.Description: Number of open interest date bands.

Field.Name: Date Bands
Field.Description: The open interest date bands carried by this message, counted by DateBandCount.

Message.Name: Position Band Message
Message.Description: Reports the number of market participants holding futures positions as a percentage of Market Open Interest.

Field.Name: BusinessDate
Field.Description: The business date for which the position band values is being reported, as YYYYMMDD.

Field.Name: ProductCode
Field.Description: Product code.

Field.Name: LongPositionBandCount
Field.Description: Number of bands for long position.

Field.Name: ShortPositionBandCount
Field.Description: Number of bands for short position.

Field.Name: Long Position Bands
Field.Description: The long position bands carried by this message, counted by LongPositionBandCount.

Field.Name: Short Position Bands
Field.Description: The short position bands carried by this message, counted by ShortPositionBandCount.

Message.Name: Warrant Band Message
Message.Description: Reports the number of market participants holding a significant percentage of warrants and positions along the front of the curve, being Tom, Cash and Cash plus one day.

Field.Name: BusinessDate
Field.Description: The business date for which the warrant band values is being reported, as YYYYMMDD.

Field.Name: WarrantBandType
Field.Description: Type of warrant band. The specification names this field Type; it is qualified here because the Reference FX Rate and Open Interest messages give a Type of their own carrying different sets of values.

Field.Name: ProductCode
Field.Description: The product code.

Field.Name: UnreportedWarrants
Field.Description: Percentage of total live, on warrant, stock that remains unreported, in implicit six decimal place format. Applicable to Type WB, otherwise null.

Field.Name: BandCount
Field.Description: Number of warrant bands.

Field.Name: Warrant Bands
Field.Description: The warrant bands carried by this message, counted by BandCount.

Message.Name: Trading Volume Message
Message.Description: Provides the traded volume in lots for matched trades in futures and options instruments. All trades resulting from Cross Order execution, whether off-book or not, are included in the trading volume calculation.

Field.Name: BusinessDate
Field.Description: The business date for which the trading volume is being reported, as YYYYMMDD.

Field.Name: TradeDate
Field.Description: The trade date for which the trading volume is being reported, as YYYYMMDD.

Field.Name: CalculationType
Field.Description: Trading volume calculation type.

Field.Name: InstrumentID
Field.Description: Unique Instrument Identifier. The specification types this field UInt64, a typo for Uint64; the type is carried as the data type table of section 3.1 defines it.

Field.Name: ProductCode
Field.Description: The product code.

Field.Name: ContractCode
Field.Description: Contract to which the instrument belongs.

Field.Name: ContractType
Field.Description: Constant contract type.

Field.Name: Volume
Field.Description: Trading volumes expressed in lots.
